messages:
Maya L: Heads-up: embeddings service throwing intermittent 503s in eu-west1. We have a candidate hotfix image. Requesting expedited deploy window and quick approvals. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback.
DeployBot: detected build: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-0301. Preflight: artifact hash verified. Attempting canary in eu-west1 -> FAILED: reserved GPU capacity exhausted.
Tom H: If eu-west1 reserved pool is OOS we can divert to eu-west3 dedicated pool or use shared pool. eu-west3 has spare capacity but slightly higher cross-region latency. Prefer dedicated eu-west3.
Ravi P: I agree eu-west3. Define rollback criteria: >0.8% 5xx over 3m or P95 latency +150ms => immediate rollback. Add these to the release note.
OpsOnCall: Approved expedited window under those rollback thresholds. Keep canary at 5% and monitor for at least 3m before moving. Page me on anomalies.
Maya L: I'll pin the image once we have a thumbs-up. Need infra smoke + model smoke before 25%.
DeployBot: action queued: start canary in eu-west3 when pinned.
Tom H: Pinned and kicking canary: `releasetool pin --svc embeddings --img registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-0301 --region eu-west3 --canary 5% --auto-rollback true`. Canary id cb-6112233445.
DeployBot: canary cb-6112233445 started at 2026-03-21T15:03Z.
Tom H: infra smoke: `curl /health` -> {"ok":true}. GPU mem stable, kv evictions down 40% in first minute.
Ravi P: model smoke: ran 40 prompts, 39 pass, 1 formatting edge case. No semantic regressions.
DeployBot: metrics @5%: 5xx=0.09%, P95 +45ms. All within thresholds.
Maya L: moving to 25%. Updating release note: "Hotfix: kv-cache eviction fix; diverted canary to eu-west3 due to eu-west1 capacity; auto-rollback on 5xx>0.8% or P95+150ms."
OpsOnCall: Monitoring. 10m watch.
Tom H: 25% steady for 5m, no anomalies. Proceeding to 100% ramp.
DeployBot: full rollout complete. Version pinned: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-0301 (pinned by Tom H).
Maya L: Thanks team. Filing postmortem ticket for eviction policy regression and reserved pool autoscale. Follow-up: add earlier spill-to-region policy.
Ravi P: Adding follow-up action: add a playbook entry for cross-region diversion during reserved capacity OOS.
DeployBot: closing canary cb-6112233445.
